verdict.rationale: Foreloop lets users start work from plain natural-language descriptions of problems (e.g. 'Users can't tell which invoices are overdue') without needing technical detail, and feedback widgets accept free-text descriptions that an agent turns into structured intentions/tasks — genuine natural-language-driven operation for specific flows. However, the primary control surfaces (CLI with --json flags, MCP tool calls, dashboard approvals) are structured, not conversational, so NL is only one entry point rather than a general command interface. Missing for 10: evidence of a chat-style NL interface for managing/approving tasks, and independent confirmation that NL descriptions reliably produce correct structured tasks.
